scope: Phase C.4: prepared full-lifecycle repository/project connection permissions with inactive private read adapters; existing task-bound inert DST correction and owner setup visibility. No private credential, paid inference, external mutation or production authority.
riskAnalysis: STRICT for credential brokers, asynchronous permission/input bindings, source-integrity and child workspace contracts. Provider installation writes are prepared only; runtime GET-only and exact fixed patch deny escalation. Semantic review and hosted browser remain unavailable.

threatModel.assets: Owner/workspace identity, provider installation keys and scopes, immutable source and audit evidence, task authority and retained financial uncertainty.
threatModel.trustBoundaries: Owner UI to guarded Ops API/CAS; task to read gateway; trusted managed broker to private GET adapter; parent to restricted fixed-data child; independent review to acceptance.
threatModel.abuseCases: Forged or stale scope, request mutation after await, cross-account substitution, late token/result after revoke, draft preimage or arbitrary command substitution, false semantic acceptance.
threatModel.mitigations: Exact identity and source checks, immutable inputs, fresh durable authorization before and after async boundaries, GET-only paths, fixed hash-locked inert patch, unresolved independent review and zero publication.

rollback: Keep paid execution and all private connections disabled. Revert only C4 application delta and redeploy disabled Preview, preserving original operational journal/evidence/holds and central revocation; never rewrite immutable history or main/Production.

negativePaths.malformed-response: Actual service/API/UI reject malformed envelopes, corrupt task records and fabricated authority; no hidden repairs.
negativePaths.stale-state: Exact plan/task revisions, source snapshot and current release guards; UI discards older revisions.
negativePaths.concurrency: Existing Redis Lua CAS enforces unique create/claim, fenced completion, and cancellation racing publication.
negativePaths.cancellation: Owner cancellation and internal emergency stop reserve cleanup slots/bytes; original completed evidence remains.
negativePaths.worker-interruption: Fixed child timeout/cancel destroys workspace; abrupt parent termination public tempdata cleanup remains unverified, untrusted code disabled.
negativePaths.api-outage: Redis read/CAS failures deny execution; unknown delivery retains exact scoped idempotency key, no automatic retry.
negativePaths.authorization-denial: Preview-only fresh session/member/workspace owner, worker/nonowner/CSRF/Production negatives and workspace-isolated journals.
negativePaths.spending-limit: Private adapters remain inactive without approved broker/gateway wiring, no inference transport or reservation writer added; existing fifteen-dollar ledger and uncertainty preserved.
negativePaths.partial-execution: Original attempt/history preserved, stale fences cannot publish, dependent tasks await verified reports and expired/cancelled work cannot recover.

defects.rootCause: GitHub adapter read input again after asynchronous credential lookup, permitting receipt source identity to drift from its query.
defects.detectionGap: Initial transport mocks validated static inputs but not mutation across the broker await.
defects.regression: Independent Auditor SHA mutation test preserves failing pre-correction artifact and requires immutable request snapshot.
defects.historicalPrevention: A receipt cannot claim a different commit than the one dispatched.

defects.rootCause: Client daily chart adds a fixed 86400000 milliseconds to local midnight, although DST local days may last 23 or 25 hours.
defects.detectionGap: Ordinary chart fixtures did not include both DST transition boundaries.
defects.regression: Exact source-linked America/Los_Angeles spring/fall fixtures prove old wrong inclusion/exclusion and inert next-calendar-midnight correction.
defects.historicalPrevention: Proposed draft fixes first daily overview chart only; authoritative source remains unchanged pending review and approval.

proactiveReview.architecture: Existing owner API/OpsCAS/task journal, original independent review, same restricted data-only child. Prepared GitHub/Vercel boundary cannot create installations or grants.
proactiveReview.dependencies: Managed provider credential broker, owner App/integration installation and dedicated hosted browser are unavailable; no credential or paid service activation. Existing source/publicCI and trusted child usable.
proactiveReview.threats: Tenant projection leaks, forged authority, stale state, dependency loops, cancellation races and corrupted receipt evidence.
proactiveReview.failureModes: Observe storage only as of real read; provider unknown; expired tasks visible; reserve bounded cleanup audit/bytes; no auto retry.
proactiveReview.faultInjection: Actual operations/API/CAS, fake only HTTP boundary; real Nodepermission child and tempfiles. No paid transport or arbitrarycode.
proactiveReview.independentChallenge: Separate QA and Auditor source inspection found and regressed GitHub input TOCTOU and inherited setup keys; DST evidence and fixed child patch reviewed independently.
proactiveReview.recovery: One owner-requested zero-provider retry within original deadline/release; cancellation, original receipts, independent QA and uncertainty are never overwritten.
proactiveReview.readiness: Frozen STRICT and real Redis, CI/CodeQL, exact READY release, actual owner five-stage source-to-calendar-patch/destruction and final unresolved report required; private access/browser remains gated.
